title: puccinellia distans var. tenuifolia
intro: Puccinellia distans var. tenuifolia, commonly known as Slender Puccinellia or Chinese Puccinellia, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Puccinellia distans var. tenuifolia include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
